svg.text: Before the interview: every CV is screened, the interviewer decides, and shortlisted candidates get an invitation. Both workflows pause for a person.
Read the CV and apply the rule. One run per
CV. Code reads the file; a weak PDF is read
once by the AI. One AI call builds the
profile (asked again once). A fixed Python
rule decides passed, excluded or needs
Score, save and wait for the person. One AI
qualifications with quotes; code checks the
quotes, counts ATS keywords and the
weighted score. PAUSE: hr_review waits for
include / exclude, and the decision can be
changed later. An include / exclude click
on a finished run starts it at hr_review.
One run per interview. The AI never sees
code puts the real link in. PAUSE until
Send. Write again (+ change): the AI
improves the email on the page, e.g.
shorter. The same checks run every time.
Purple dashed = loop back · grey dashed = skip ahead · red dashed = to failed · blue dashed box = the run pauses until a person answers
